classification_caveat: engine/both are diagnostic candidates, not a count of proven bugs. Saved references and pinned PoB2 are cross-checks, not game truth. Known rows retain narrow source evidence; no whole build is declared correct from numerical agreement.
measurement_limits: Saved exporter values and pinned PoB2 are cross-checks, not game truth.
FullDPS is not calculated; damage uses selected main minion TotalDPS when its saved reference is nonzero.
Exporter-absent rules and timing models are disabled for reference comparison; focused native regressions cover the added rules.
Runtime errors fail triage, but numerical disagreement is reported rather than treated as a test failure.
Structural audit of this frozen corpus is separate; multi-set/historical/disabled/malformed import cases were not present in that corpus.

inputs.change: Only the proven tuned ReqInt grant exemption baseline and documentation/known row changed since measured45a3c00a; no calculation changes.

validation.holdout_scope: Aggregate accuracy only; no individual holdout inspected.
validation.browser_scope: Web typecheck/unit tests and Rust WASM/JSON contracts; 508 Web tests passed, 5 skipped (3 opt-in benchmark tests and 2 useBuildSession WASM tests). No actual browser interaction validation claimed.
validation.independent_reviews: See review-summary.json; focused regression execution belongs to the implementation commits.
validation.reference_scope: The accuracy gate covers benchmark/tuned/holdout. The separate triage measurement covers the full230 frozen cohort and77 worked builds; numerical disagreement is diagnostic.

completion_status: Incomplete: complete inventory audit identified nine further static defects across22 builds, assigned to the next batch; see completion-scope-audit.json.
remaining_limits: Unverified intrinsic minion Life-to-ES deduction, Runic Plate snapshots and several residual damage/level/reservation rows remain explicit in triage.
No inferred kill history, Offering consumption, Headhunter buffs, minion Rage or sustained flask uptime is added.
Spirit Walker09 Rage III recipient-state question remains unresolved.
Unique Herald/Blink mappings are supported by game attachment tables; the separate Oracle04 five-point Spirit pool difference remains unresolved.
Finite flask recovery is available separately; it is not automatically aggregated into permanent regeneration.
Game rounding is not changed solely for exporter agreement.
Retained enableGlobal1/2 flags contain no explicit false in this frozen corpus; legacy false-state interpretation is not validated and existing ordinary-buff alternate-set behavior is preserved.
Passing imports and calculation checks do not establish complete support for every modifier or all malformed/historical/multi-set inputs.
